description: Defines structures, classes, and interfaces related to Channel Access Control (CAC) status management in the prplMesh project, including CAC channel lists, completion status, and an interface for updating and retrieving CAC status information.

classes.name: CacStatusInterface
classes.description: Abstract interface for managing CAC status data, including updating status database and retrieving channel lists and completion status.

methods.name: update_cac_status_db
methods.description: Updates all collected channel information for a given radio.

methods.name: get_available_channels
methods.description: Returns a list of CAC-available channels for a specified radio MAC address.

methods.name: get_non_occupancy_channels
methods.description: Returns a list of channels that cannot be occupied due to radar detection for a specified radio MAC address.

methods.name: get_active_channels
methods.description: Returns a list of channels with ongoing CAC for a specified radio MAC address.

methods.name: get_completion_status
methods.description: Returns the CAC completion status object for a given radio.
